galaxy_s25.content:
Samsung Galaxy S25

Samsung Galaxy S25:
Price: $799.99 (128GB, US launch)
Storage: 128GB / 256GB, no microSD card slot
Display: 6.2-inch Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, FHD+ (1080×2340)
Processor: Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy, 12GB RAM
Announced: January 22, 2025

Cameras:
Rear: 50MP wide-angle, 12MP ultra wide, 10MP telephoto with 3x optical zoom
Front: 12MP selfie camera

Battery and Charging:
Battery: 4000mAh, up to 29 hours of video playback (Samsung)
Wired charging: 25W
Wireless charging: 15W (Qi2 Ready)

Build and Software:
Frame: Armor Aluminum, Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 display
Water and dust resistance: IP68
Weight: 162 g
Software: Android 15 with One UI 7

How It Differs from the Galaxy S25 Ultra:
The Galaxy S25 is the compact, standard model: a 6.2-inch display, a 4000mAh battery and an aluminum frame. It has no S Pen and no 200MP camera, which are found on the larger Galaxy S25 Ultra.

Common Questions:
Q: How much memory does the Galaxy S25 have? A: 12GB of RAM, with 128GB or 256GB of storage.
Q: Does it have an S Pen? A: No.
Q: How fast does it charge? A: 25W wired and 15W wireless.
Q: Is it water resistant? A: Yes, it is rated IP68.

galaxy_s25_ultra.content: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra: Price: $1,299.99 (256GB, US launch) Storage: 256GB / 512GB / 1TB, no microSD card slot Colors: Titanium Silverblue, Titanium Black, Titanium Gray, Titanium Whitesilver; Samsung.com-only: Titanium Jetblack, Titanium Jadegreen, Titanium Pinkgold Display: 6.9-inch Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, 1440×3120 Processor: Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy, 12GB RAM

Announced: January 22, 2025

Cameras:
Rear: 200MP wide-angle, 50MP ultra wide, 50MP telephoto with 5x optical zoom, 10MP telephoto with 3x optical zoom
Front: 12MP selfie camera

Battery and Charging:
Battery: 5000mAh, up to 31 hours of video playback (Samsung)
Wired charging: 45W
Wireless charging: 15W (Qi2 Ready)

Build and Software:
Frame: titanium, Corning Gorilla Armor 2 front glass
Water and dust resistance: IP68
Weight: 218 g
Software: Android 15 with One UI 7
S Pen: built in, slides out of the phone body

How It Differs from the Galaxy S25:
The Galaxy S25 Ultra is the largest and most capable phone of the Galaxy S25 family: a 6.9-inch display, a 5000mAh battery, a 200MP main camera and a built-in S Pen. The standard Galaxy S25 is a smaller 6.2-inch phone without an S Pen.

Common Questions:
Q: Does the Galaxy S25 Ultra have a microSD slot? A: No, storage is fixed at 256GB, 512GB or 1TB.
Q: Does it support the S Pen? A: Yes, the S Pen is built in.
Q: How fast does it charge? A: 45W wired and 15W wireless.
Q: How many cameras are on the back? A: Four: 200MP wide, 50MP ultra wide, and 50MP 5x and 10MP 3x telephoto.

honda.content: Honda Civic: Base Price: $24,000 (Sedan LX) / $24,950 (Hatchback LX) Trims: LX, Sport, EX, EX-L, Sport Touring, Si, Type R Engine Options: - 2.0L 4-cylinder: 158 hp, 138 lb-ft torque (LX/Sport) - 1.5L turbocharged 4-cylinder: 192 hp, 192 lb-ft torque (EX and above) - Civic Si: 1.5L turbo, 200 hp, 6-speed manual only - Civic Type R: 2.0L VTEC Turbo, 315 hp, 6-speed manual, 0–60 in 5.4 sec

Transmission: CVT standard; 6-speed manual on Si and Type R Fuel Economy: Up to 36 mpg city / 46 mpg highway (1.5T CVT) Safety: Honda Sensing suite standard on all trims (CMBS, LKAS, ACC, RDM) Infotainment: 7-inch or 9-inch Honda CONNECT touchscreen, Apple CarPlay / Android Auto wireless Colors: Sonic Gray Pearl, Aegean Blue, Rallye Red, Lunar Silver, Crystal Black, Boost Blue (Type R)

Honda Financing & Service:
Honda Financial Services: Financing from 0.9% APR (well-qualified buyers), lease options available
Honda Care (Extended Warranty): Available up to 8 years / 120,000 miles
Maintenance Minder: Oil life monitoring system, standard on all models
Roadside Assistance: 3-year / 36,000-mile roadside assistance included with new vehicle purchase

Performance Trims:
Civic Si: sedan only, 1.5L turbo, 200 hp and 192 lb-ft, 6-speed manual only
Civic Type R: hatchback only, 2.0L turbo, 315 hp and 310 lb-ft, 6-speed manual only
Civic LX: 2.0L 4-cylinder, 158 hp and 138 lb-ft, CVT

Common Questions:
Q: Which Civic trims come with a manual transmission? A: The Si and the Type R, both 6-speed manual only.
Q: Does the Civic come as a hatchback? A: Yes, the LX is offered as a sedan or hatchback, and the Type R is a hatchback.
Q: Does every Civic have Honda Sensing? A: Yes, it is standard on all trims.
Q: How long is the powertrain warranty? A: 5 years or 60,000 miles.

macbook.content: MacBook Pro 16-inch: Price: Starting at $2,000 Processor: M4 Max chip — 14-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine Memory: 36GB / 48GB / 64GB / 96GB / 128GB unified memory Storage: 512GB / 1TB / 2TB / 4TB SSD Display: 16.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR, 3456×2234, ProMotion 120Hz, 1000 nits sustained / 1600 nits peak Battery: Up to 24 hours, 140W USB-C fast charge

Magic Mouse: $79
Magic Trackpad: $129

Thunderbolt 5: on the M4 Pro and M4 Max models
M4 Max: configurable up to a 16-core CPU and 40-core GPU, with up to 128GB of unified memory

Common Questions:
Q: How many Thunderbolt ports does the MacBook Pro 16-inch have? A: Three Thunderbolt 5 ports, plus HDMI 2.1, an SDXC card slot and MagSafe 3.
Q: How much memory can it have? A: Up to 128GB of unified memory.
Q: Does it have a headphone jack? A: Yes, a 3.5mm headphone jack.
Q: How does it charge? A: Through MagSafe 3 or USB-C, with 140W fast charging.

ps5_pro.content:
PlayStation 5 Pro

Sony PlayStation 5 Pro:
Price: $699.99 (US launch, digital-only console)
Storage: 2TB SSD
Disc drive: not included; optional Disc Drive sold separately
Included: DualSense wireless controller, Astro's Playroom pre-installed
Announced: September 10, 2024, pre-orders from September 26, 2024
Released: November 7, 2024

Performance:
GPU: Sony quoted 67% more compute units than the PS5, 28% faster memory and up to 45% faster rendering
Upscaling: PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), AI-based
Display output: variable refresh rate (VRR), up to 8K output
Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi 7 where available

Add-ons and Comparison:
Disc Drive (sold separately): $79.99
Standard PS5 at the time of the PS5 Pro launch: $499.99, or $449.99 for the Digital Edition

Common Questions:
Q: Does the PS5 Pro have a disc drive? A: Not built in, the optional Disc Drive is sold separately.
Q: How much storage does it have? A: 2TB of SSD storage.
Q: What is PSSR? A: PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, an AI-based upscaling feature.
Q: Does it support Wi-Fi 7? A: Yes, where a compatible router is available.

switch_2.content:
Nintendo Switch 2

Nintendo Switch 2:
Price: $449.99 (console only, US launch)
Storage: 256GB (UFS)
Display: 7.9-inch wide color gamut LCD, 1920×1080, HDR10, variable refresh rate up to 120Hz
Processor: custom processor made by NVIDIA
Released: June 5, 2025

Display Output and Performance:
TV mode: up to 3840×2160 (4K) at 60fps, up to 120fps at 1080p or 1440p
Handheld and tabletop mode: up to 1920×1080
Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi 6

Battery and Controllers:
Battery: 5220mAh lithium-ion, about 2 to 6.5 hours depending on the game
Charging time: about 3 hours
Joy-Con 2: each has a mouse sensor, plus an accelerometer and gyroscope
Storage expansion: microSD Express cards only, up to 2TB

Weight:
Console: about 0.88 lb, about 1.18 lb with Joy-Con 2 attached

Bundles and Compatibility:
Nintendo Switch 2 and Mario Kart World Bundle at launch: $499.99
Both Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch game cards can be inserted into the console.

Common Questions:
Q: How much storage does the Switch 2 have? A: 256GB of built-in storage, expandable with microSD Express cards up to 2TB.
Q: Does it play in 4K? A: Yes, on a TV in TV mode, up to 4K at 60fps.
Q: How long does the battery last? A: About 2 to 6.5 hours, depending on the game.
Q: Do regular microSD cards work? A: Only for copying screenshots and videos, games need microSD Express.

toyota_camry.content:
Toyota Vehicle

Toyota Camry (2025):
Base Price: $28,400 (LE hybrid, before the $1,095 destination fee)
Trims: LE, SE, XLE, XSE
Powertrain: 2.5L four-cylinder hybrid, hybrid-only lineup for 2025
Drive: front-wheel drive standard, all-wheel drive optional on every trim
Fuel Economy: 51 mpg combined (Toyota estimate, LE front-wheel drive)
Seating: five
Cargo: 15.1 cubic feet

Pricing Notes:
The LE with the $1,095 destination fee comes to $29,495.
All-wheel drive adds $1,525 on every trim.

Warranty:
Basic: 3-year / 36,000-mile

Common Questions:
Q: Is the 2025 Camry a hybrid? A: Yes, every 2025 Camry is a hybrid.
Q: Does the 2025 Camry offer all-wheel drive? A: Yes, as a $1,525 option on all trims.
Q: How many trims are there? A: Four: LE, SE, XLE and XSE.
Q: Does the starting figure include destination? A: No, the $28,400 base excludes the $1,095 destination fee.
